spans.s:
नय 1. नय्, cl. 1. A. नयते, नेये, नयि-
तुम्, to go, move; to protect; [cf. rt.
1. नी.]

नय नय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. नी), guiding,
leading, directing, managing; manner of conducting
one's self, behaviour, conduct, course of conduct, way
of life, management; prudent conduct or behaviour,
good management; prudence, reason; polity, policy,
political wisdom, state-policy, political economy,
statesmanship, civil administration, government; any
work on policy or political economy; Prudence or
Policy personified as a son of Dharma and Kriyā;
plan, design; leading thought, maxim, principle;
opinion, system, course, method; philosophical
[]
system; the philosophical part of the Veda (?); a
kind of game; a sort of dice or men for playing this
game [cf. नय-पीठी]; a move in this game (?);
N. of a son of the thirteenth Manu; (अस्, आ, अम्), =
नेतृ, leading, guiding, conducting; a leader, guide;
= न्याय, fit, right, proper.
—नय-कोविद, अस्,
आ, अम्, skilled in policy, prudent.
—नय-ग, अस्,
आ, अम्, following a system.
—नय-चक्षुस्, उस्,
उस्, उस्, having political foresight, wise, prudent.
—नय-जा, f., N. of the wife of king Brahma-dāsa,
father of Nārāyaṇa, who composed the Praśnārṇava.
—नय-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing polity, prudent;
knowing any system, a follower of any system.
—नय-नेतृ, ता, m. a master in policy or politics.
—नय-पाल, अस्, m. ‘protector of policy,’ N. of a
man; of a king.
—नय-पीठी, f. the board or cloth
on which dice or men are moved in play.
—नय-
प्रयोग, अस्, m. policy, political wisdom or address.
—नय-लोचन, अम्, n. ‘the eye of policy,’ N. of
a work.
—नय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, familiar with
policy, versed in polity, prudent; containing any
form of rt. 1. नी (as a Ṛk).
—नय-विद्, त्, त्, त्,
or नय-विशारद, अस्, आ, अम्, m. knowing polity,
skilled in policy, a politician, statesman.
—नय-
शालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, possessing political wisdom, endowed
with prudence.
—नय-शास्त्र, अम्, n. any work on
policy or political economy, the doctrine of polity.
—नय-सार, अस्, m. ‘essence of polity,’ N. of a
treatise.
—नय-सिद्धि, इस्, f. political success, ac-
complishing anything by good management.

नाय नाय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. नी), a leader,
guide, driver (e. g. in अश्व-न्˚, गो-न्˚); perhaps N.
of a man; = नय, guiding, directing (morally or
physically); policy; means, expedient.

नयक, अस्, आ, अम्, a skilful manager, clever in
policy or political administration.

नायक, अस्, इका, अम्, guiding, leading, con-
ducting; (अस्), m. a guide, leader, conductor [cf.
कु-न्˚]; a chief, lord, head; pre-eminent, principal;
(with or without सैन्यस्य) a general, a com-
mander; (in erotic or dramatic poetry) the lover or
hero in a drama &c., a husband; the central gem of
a necklace; a paradigm or example (in grammar);
an epithet of Śākya-muni; N. of a Brāhman; (इका),
f. a mistress; a wife; the heroine in a drama &c., a
noble lady; an inferior form or Śakti of Durgā, (of
which there are eight, viz. Ugra-caṇḍā, Pra-caṇḍā,
Caṇḍogrā, Caṇḍa-nāyikā, Ati-caṇḍā, Cāmuṇḍā,
Caṇḍā, and Caṇḍā-vatī; cf. कुल-न्˚.)
—नायक-
त्व, अम्, n. leadership, headship, chieftainship.
—नायक-रत्न, अम्, n., N. of a commentary
on Pārtha-sārathi's Nyāya-ratna-mālā by Rāmānuja.
—नायकाधिप (˚क-अध्˚), अस्, m. the chief of
leaders, a king, sovereign, prince.

नयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, leading, guiding; tending
or conducing to; informing, certifying, giving evi-
dence, obtaining.

नयन, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आ or ई), f. the
pupil of the eye; (अम्), n. leading, guiding, con-
ducting, managing; governing, directing, ruling;
leading or bringing to, drawing; (with कालस्य),
passing or spending (time); attaining, obtaining;
‘the guiding or leading organ,’ the eye.
—नयन-
गोचर, अस्, आ, अम्, perceptible by the eye, within
the range of vision, visible, apparent.
—नयन-
च्छद, अस्, m. ‘eye-covering,’ an eyelid.
—न-
यन-जल, अम्, n. ‘eye-water,’ tears.
—नयन-
पथ, अस्, m. range or field of sight.
—नयन-
पुट, अस्, अम्, m. n. (?), the eyelid.
—नयन-वारि,
इ, n. ‘eye-water,’ tears.
—नयन-विषय, अस्, m.
‘field of vision, range of sight,’ the horizon.
—न-
यन-सलिल, अम्, n. ‘eye-water,’ tears.
—नय-
नाञ्जन (˚न-अञ्˚), अम्, n. any ointment for the
eye.
—नयनानन्द (˚न-आन्˚) or नयनानन्द-
शर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a commentator on the Amara-
koṣa.
—नयनामोषिन् (˚न-आम्˚), ई, इणी, इ, ‘sight-
stealing,’ blinding.
—नयनोत्सव (˚न-उत्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, ‘eye-festival,’ any lovely or desired object; a
lamp.
—नयनोद (˚न-उद), अम्, n. eye-water;
[cf. नयन-सलिल.]
—नयनोपान्त (˚न-उप्˚),
अस्, m. the outer angle or corner of the eye, the
canthus.
—नयनौषध (˚न-ओष्˚), अम्, n.
‘eye-medicament,’ green sulphate of iron or that
salt in a state of partial decomposition by exposure
to the atmosphere (used as a collyrium).
नयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be conducted or brought.

नयिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. leading in the best
manner.

नयुत नयुत, अस्, अम्, m. n. (?), 100,000
millions.

नय्यग्रोध नय्यग्रोध, अस्, ई, अम्, (fr. न्य-
ग्रोध), Ved. relating to or produced from the
sacred fig-tree; (also read नैयग्रोध.)

नायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, leading, conducting; [cf. अयु-
त-न्˚.]
